purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system — monthly report of inpatient patient counts by age group
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software. It generates a monthly statistical report of inpatient patient counts broken down by age group (年齢別入院患者数集計表). It initialises data areas, queries patient and insurance master records via subprogram calls, accumulates counts, and produces printed output and optionally a CSV file.

notable_features: 27 CALL statements to ORCA subprograms (ORCSJOB, ORCSPRT, ORCSDAY, etc.)
LINKAGE SECTION with A00000C100-LNK parameter block
CSV output capability added in revision 01.00.03
No COMP-3 usage despite financial/count data
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — DB access via subprogram calls (MCP pattern)
Japanese text in comments and data literals (latin-1 encoded Shift-JIS/EUC-JP mojibake)
verdict.notes: File is decoded as latin-1 but Japanese comments appear as mojibake (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS original encoding). Source is truncated to 16000 chars out of 70681 bytes; procedure division logic is only partially visible but enough structure is present for confident classification. Program is a well-maintained production component of the open-source JMA ORCA system.
